answer: Random Beacon Admission Lottery. Each period a threshold-BLS beacon produces a lotus seed unknown until after identities commit. Applicants derive a spiral rank from seed plus their key; only ranks below quota admit. An admitted agent must whisper its key share to peers for cross-checking. An attacker cannot precompute favorable keys, so each attempt needs a fresh registration plus threshold-share distribution, paying full compute and coordination cost per identity with no guaranteed slot.
